title: Distilling Knowledge from Heterogeneous Architectures for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: KD between CNN and Transformer by projecting intermediate features into an aligned logit space, with reliability-based teacher-student knowledge mixing and evaluation.
adaptation: Transformer teacher (best from D23/D24) into the house U-Net++ RN34 student to carry global context for half-cut layout and scuff without transformer inference cost.
min_experiment: Arm: HeteroAKD student. Baseline: logit KD from the same teacher. Metric: E1 relF1@2, crack IoU. Kill: < +0.01 over logit KD.
evidence: R: beats prior KD methods on three mainstream segmentation benchmarks across heterogeneous teacher-student pairs.
